experiments.scope: Run the shipped frozen-plan generator and require byte-exact prog.bin and body.bin hashes, decode the 39-bit instructions, execute their JAL/JR schedule on eight full-width points, require a 146036-operation trace, and compare every output with scalar Keccak. Decode the 949-instruction controller and exercise evalF, a matching probe, a full-table no-match probe, restart with slot wrap, trail-cap rejection, successful replay/recovery and false-key replay failure. Then derive 17 full-width points per organizer seed, run four r24 chain steps and return the first 12-bit agreement.
experiments.hypothesis: The shipped generators and packed interpreters reproduce the claimed step and controller, including the paths needed for table lookup, restart and recovery. Under an independent uniform 12-bit projection, 68 images contain a repeated value with probability 1-prod_(i=0..67)(1-i/4096)=0.4283525380. The organizer recomputes every returned target event. Null trials remain in the report.
